name: Ganrou ~Omoi no Mama ni~
source:
Hero wakes up at a hospital after he is hit by a truck on a road. He feels well now and is very interested in nurses garments. Surprisingly, he can now emit sound waves that makes nurses itch with lust.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
